pages.scan: Read with the Read tool from works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-04.png. Four panels. (1) Full-width top panel: Ananya box at centre-left, Ravi box at right. Ananya: 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.' (tail to Ananya). Ravi is silent. (2) Middle-left panel, Ravi box at left-centre: 'I've been feeling tired lately.' (3) Middle-right panel, Ananya box at right: rectangular narration caption 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' Ananya has no balloon here (silent reaction). (4) Full-width bottom panel: Ananya at centre-left, Ravi at right. Ananya: 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' (tail to Ananya). Ravi is silent.
pages.observation: The reading order is unambiguous: one text element per panel except panel 1, and the tails are short and point at the right face. Problems: (a) Ravi's symptom 'I've been feeling tired lately' gets a narration caption over a silent Ananya in panel 3 instead of a spoken reaction. The narrator's general message interrupts the consultation. Ananya's eventual reply in panel 4 is generic ('your concerns') and never acknowledges the tiredness or asks a follow-up, so the reply to the symptom feels skipped or delayed. The art must give Ananya a clear listening expression in panel 3, or the caption reads as a non-sequitur. (b) The left/right layout flips. In panels 1 and 4, Ananya is left and Ravi is right. In panels 2 and 3, Ravi's single shot is on the left and Ananya's is on the right. Unless the art handles the angle deliberately, this reads as the two characters swapping sides. (c) Ravi never reacts in panel 4 and the page ends on Ananya's line, so his response (relief or agreement) is not shown. (d) The setting is never stated on this page, though 'Hello, Ravi' implies a consultation. All text is readable.
